0001-object-renumbering-and-heartbeats.p.why: Capture the RSDKV4-Decompilation worktree's uncommitted edits: per-game object and function renumbering (typeBase/functionBase) so Sonic 1 and Sonic 2 can share one script table, a hashed rather than linear object-name lookup, and HEARTBEAT frame-loop instrumentation. These were edited in place in the submodule and existed nowhere in this repository, so a fresh clone built a different binary than the one every recorded measurement came from. The heartbeat sites are compiled out by default behind HYBRID_HEARTBEAT_LOG; the Audio.cpp change is unrelated to instrumentation and is a real fix - a bounded fill loop and a consecutive-empty-read counter in ProcessMusicStream, because a seek back to the loop point that yields no samples made ov_read spin forever at 100% CPU with no further log output.
